note: Run by Whiterock Conservancy (nonprofit land trust). Ridge-top oak grove with gravel pads, 40 mi of trails; campers in recent years found little shade and a busy gravel road alongside. Also has 17 horse pens but is a general RV campground, not equestrian-only. Sites sit on the ridge, not on water. --Claude
summary: Conservancy page confirms 14 electric (6 pull-through, 8 back-in), hydrants not site water, dump, shower house, $20. Toilets and potable water added. Not waterfront holds; private gate passes.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: rate $20 posted on its own page (2026 read, copyright footer 2022, stored read 2026-10-15). No gateway within 40 km (nearest Kansas City 303 km), not needed. Presence: own website, phone 712-790-8221 matches. Price: posted + online booking. Google 4.6 on 23 reviews (under 25, doesn't matter with a website). Not long-stay: nothing about monthly or seasonal.
OWNERSHIP: `private` is right for a nonprofit-run campground (Whiterock Conservancy, nonprofit land trust).

REVIEWS read (Google): 4 months ago 'Very quite campground. We stayed for 4 days... Great place for equestrian camping. Sites are on the large size... very little shade'; 2 months ago 'So peaceful and very friendly camp hosts'; 7 years ago 'sits next to a fairly busy gravel' road; 3 years ago, noise from a worker's house next to the campground.
EQUESTRIAN: 'an ideal destination for both outdoor enthusiasts and horse owners'; RVs welcome at '$20 per RV', so stays. Google reviewer calls it equestrian camping.

Pin 41.82677,-94.63650 is at the entrance on 125th St, ~130 m NW of the loops' centre (about 41.8262,-94.6352 on imagery): no move needed. WATERFRONT holds: open pasture ridge; only a small stock pond south of the loops.
